selection_basis: Mechanism falsification before any new counterexample data; no development screening and no selection by performance.

candidates.factor: Round generated continuous Doppler using numpy round; keep 8 path draws, delays and raw gains; same G0 normalization after expansion.
candidates.reason: Removes fractional leakage; tests whether benefit specifically depends on linking sidelobes.

candidates.factor: Modify only labelled physical slots0/1 geometry before G0 expansion. First cache c=clip(original k0,-1.75,1.75); then simultaneously set l1=l0, k0=c-0.125, k1=c+0.125. Keep all 8 raw gains and other six geometries.
candidates.reason: Same-delay paths separated by0.25 Doppler bins challenge observable center selection and hard grouping. Labels chosen before draws; no error/rank/energy rejection sampling.

candidates.reason: Less direct test of relation mismatch; not chosen under two-scene budget.

candidates.reason: Changes data SNR and pilot quality together; report both if future authorized.

candidates.reason: Different propagation model requires separate explicit approval and separate G0/G1 report; not admitted here.

shared_contract.G0: unchanged Dirichlet normalization/prune/clipping convention; overlapping coefficients sum complex; common Frobenius normalization of each scenario channel before arms
shared_contract.transmit: pilot/data already scaled; y=H@(pilot+data)+sqrt(sigma2)*noise; no per-arm/per-frame transmit normalization
shared_contract.receiver_information: observed y/pilot/sigma2/constellation and frozen receiver parameters only; scenario true geometry and true P not receiver inputs
shared_contract.failures: Keep every scheduled block, including cancellation/zero-channel/rank deficiency; explicit generation invalidity stops run rather than redraw; no frame filtering.

scenes.mechanism_prediction: Linking benefit over classical parameterization should attenuate when leakage vanishes; this direction is descriptive, not an equivalence claim.
scenes.likely_failure: Wrong fractional templates or unnecessary shrinkage bias; integer collisions and normalized channel energy changes reported separately.

scenes.mechanism_prediction: Soft relation should tolerate overlap better than hard local parameterization; failure to select two centers can erase advantage.
scenes.likely_failure: Merged centers or ill-conditioned overlapping templates cause bias; record rank, selected center count, fallback frequency and raw/normalized energy.

sampling.pairing: Disjoint global block IDs define independent scene streams. All arms and SNR reuse each block channel/codeword/normalized noise. No optional stopping.
arms_roles: strongest applicable classical structural deployment comparator
sampling.arm_binding: Exact IDs/config/source hashes bound from FREEZE-01 before generator access; no scene-specific tuning. If strong references exceed3, resolve fairly in FREEZE-01, not by deleting an unresolved comparator.

statistics.family: 2 scenes x 2 fixed references; simultaneous two-sided95% via four CP tails per comparison and Bonferroni

decision_table.pass: All four lower bounds > -0.01 and all widths <=0.04; no implementation/information violations. A robustness pass does not establish positive gain or mechanism attribution.
decision_table.fail: Any upper bound < -0.01 establishes material harm for that comparison; other comparisons remain separately labelled.
decision_table.insufficient: All other cases, including wide intervals, zero errors without adequate bounds, failed/incomplete jobs. Never relabel as pass.
decision_table.per_scene: Apply the pass/fail/insufficient rules to each scene two fixed-reference comparisons separately; overall pass requires both scenes pass; report both labels and all intervals.
decision_table.invalid: Information/implementation violations are invalid evidence, not evidence of scientific performance failure.

statistics.neighbors: 7/9dB retain paired counts and intervals as descriptive stress evidence; no additional simultaneous no-harm claim. Adverse effects must be disclosed.
statistics.mechanism_diagnostics: NMSE, cancellation/data-H residuals, template ranks and fallback counts are secondary; no selection or substitution for FER.

zero_discordance_check.interpretation: 128 blocks give interval ±4.406% even at zero discordance, so strict1% no-harm/4% width certification cannot be promised. This budget supports failure evidence or insufficient evidence rather than a complete robustness pass. FREEZE-01 must disclose scientific gate feasibility; do not silently relax margins or increase samples.

statistics.threshold_origin: SCENE-01 prospective conservative engineering standard, not an inherited campaign rule: campaign 1% neighbor margin applies to main G0 7/9dB; applying1% to these counterexamples and width4% is explicitly new here. No scenario outcomes observed.

budget.resource_admission: Use actual M full cost and remaining shared ledger in FREEZE-01; this static preregistration does not authorize launch or override resource limits.
budget.no_additional_CE_or_terminal: Any standalone diagnostic calls require separately admitted existing budgets; full-run diagnostics cannot hide extra receiver calls.

verification.scope: Static preregistration and analytic binomial zero-discordance bound only; no simulated or real scenario data generated.
